أَسْعَرُ , applied to a man, Of the colour termed سُعْرَةٌ: fem. سَعْرَآءُ. (TA.) ―
-b2- And, so applied, (TA,) Having little flesh, (K, TA,) lean, or lank in the belly, (TA,) having the sinews apparent, altered in colour or complexion, or emaciated, (K, TA,) and slender. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
